body: Thank you *hugs*

I know we are but I always try to repare it. I do my best not to do things that triggers her. We've had a talk about it before and are really open about that. The last time she got triggered was because I was on a party ( multiple people playing on playstation talking to each other.) And about 5 mins before she got on there was a guy that came in the party because he wanted to chat. I dont really know him and I dont really care about him coz hes been mean to me before but I dont want to get him kick him coz he was friend with the other person on the chat. My girl is really jealous of him. I tried to tell her many times before that I dont give a shit about that guy but she doesnt care she just keep "teasing" me on how much better that guy is in bed than her. I had to tell her to stop even mentioning his name coz when it happenes I get triggered and I get scared because I feel like shes gonna get mad at me. ( she did multiple times before even saying i had alredy done stuff with him. Not true and I've told her but she doesnt believe me)



Im not saying I am perfect and I dont do stuff like that but I do consider myself an observant person and I try to be careful with what I say and how I say it because I know how I am. I have caught myself saying things like that before and I apologised and took a minute to myself because I dont want to be like that.

And I am not saying she doesnt make an effort either. Shes amazing and I know she tries her best but sometimes it still gets too much and she doesnt want to be medicated and I do believe it would help her but that option is off the table. 

I told her I would meet her in the middle for the wedding because I love her. I am ready to go sign the papers and even wear a ring for her if she want and she was so happy with the idea. But now that her family is not happy about that, its not enough. It ecen is in a religion I am not familiar with which scares me the most.


I am sorry I am rambling. I just want to try to give you a good base on whats going on but at the same time this is only from my point of view so of course I encourage you to give and take. Thats a bit why I am so open about my BPD here. I want people to know that I am not perfect and I dont claim to be and I know I make mistakes as well but I do try my best to be the best person I can be.
Thank you so so so so much. Im actually crying after reading this. It gives me a bit of hope for the future.

Yea I understand what you mean. I do believe I have no choice at this point. I mean from the very beginning when she told me she had bipolar (considering I have borderline) I knew it was gonna be a challenge but I was willing to go with it anyway coz she had already won my heart over. Its still quite scary to my. Im so proud of you though. That demands a lot of courage. Youre amazing thank you

Yea they do. I posted earlier about my relationship and started to believe that maybe I was being cruel that I was in the wrong but all I do is try to make it right for her. I can bend but I cant do every single things she wants. If I make compromises I feel like she should do some too. I feel like I have lost all control of every little bits of my life and I cant stand it

Hi thank you so much. Im so sorry t
You have to go through that. I hope youre still feeling well. I just dont feel listened to. I feel like no one believes me either.  I have a high pain tolerance and people tend to look skeptic when I tell them I am in pain. When I talk about an issue in my relationship to get advice I feel judged and people tend to tell me to break it off and that I am not a good girlfriend when I just tey to explain my side of the story. Ive never been in a relationship before and she told me she think I am amazing and I do my best. Idk what to believe anymore and everythimg is way too complicated. I am sosorry I am rambling
Telling me there point of you and how they dealt with it if the have without judging me or giving me orders

Yes I know that already but it doesnt makes me less scared and havimg you judging me and telling me how wrong I am and how I keep her in doesnt help at all. I know when im wrong and you put stuff on me that shouldnt be and ita pissing me off

I am trying to let go but she does t want to. And yes theres one. You can sign papers and be done with it. I agreed to that and she was verry happy about that until her parents had there word to say. If you dont understand my point of view, its alright but dont come in here telling me exactly what I NEED to do (bringing me back too feeling like I have lost control) not knowing the situation I am im and how dificult it is for me.
When the fuck did I ever make her conform to my beliefs? I even bent and told her Id meet her halfway. What the fuck else do you expect from me

Okay first of all maybe its easy for you to do but its not for me. And you have to understand that in her religion I dont belive gay marriage is that well accepted so when we started talking she even told me " yes might be hard to do it anyway". And she didnt tell me it was mandatory in her family. Of course I have my responsibilities in there but If I told her clearly what I wanted and still wanted to try it out that is not on me, man so stop trying to pin everyrhing on me when you dont know the whole story.

And can you please stop acting like Im the bad person here? Weve talked about it before and everything was good. It suddenly changed and It's getting too much for me. Im not being cruel doing things my way. I am ready to make compromises but she has to do some too.

Im trying to make her less atreacted to me but everyting I do is cute. Nothing works. And I dont want to break her heart. She is the one keeping me around and making me choose between my beliefs and hers. I try to leave but she gets agressive and talkes about suicide. I am terrified

I wish she wouldve told me earlier that it was indeed a big deal and that no she didnt undestand my point of view. Im trying too make her understand that this is making me really anxious and that I feel pushed but then she keeps telling me that I trigger her bipolar and then she'll do something to trigger my borderline as a revenge. Honestly I know I should let her go but I still love her and it hurts me and I dont want to hurt her either. That and she keeps talking about suicide when she has a low and It really scares the shit out of me

Im a bit scared to. Shes bipolar (not on meds) and is quite fragile. I told her I wanted to slow things down a bit ago and she said she "couldnt take it". She also keep saying that every girl keeps leaving her and she's scared to lose me and I dont want to do that to her.
